goal: 电话确认合作细节并达成一致

n1.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n1.line: Good morning. This is David Davis from Meridian Trading. I am calling on behalf of our purchasing department regarding the autumn order.
n1.lineCn: 早上好。我是 Meridian 贸易公司的 David Davis。我代表采购部就秋季订单一事致电。

grammar.name: 介词短语 on behalf of / regarding
grammar.note: on behalf of 代表……,regarding 关于、就……而言,二者是商务电话开场的地道表达。

options.text: Good morning, Mr. Davis. I was expecting your call in connection with the revised contract.
options.textCn: 早上好,Davis 先生。我正期待您关于修订合同的来电。

options.text: Good morning. I am afraid I know nothing about any autumn order.
options.textCn: 早上好。恐怕我对秋季订单一无所知。
options.feedback: 业务不清,对方说明来意。

options.text: Could you call back later? I am in the middle of a meeting at the moment.
options.textCn: 您能晚点打来吗?我正在开会。
options.feedback: 婉拒通话,对方争取机会。

n2.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n2.line: Perfect. In terms of delivery time, we hope to receive the first batch by the end of October.
n2.lineCn: 很好。就交货时间而言,我们希望十月底前收到第一批货。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in terms of
grammar.note: in terms of 就……而言、在……方面,是商务讨论中最常用的限定讨论范围的介词短语。

options.text: That should be feasible in terms of our current production capacity.
options.textCn: 就我们目前的生产能力而言,这是可行的。

options.text: By the end of October? Due to the holiday season, our factory will be short of hands.
options.textCn: 十月底?由于假期临近,我们工厂会人手不足。

options.text: I cannot commit without checking with the production department first.
options.textCn: 不先和生产部确认,我无法承诺。

n3.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n3.line: I see. In light of our long partnership, I would appreciate it if you could look into the order.
n3.lineCn: 我明白了。鉴于我们长期的合作关系,希望您能查一下这笔订单。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in light of
grammar.note: in light of 鉴于、考虑到,正式书面语,用于说明理由与背景。

options.text: You are right. I will search for the order details in our system right away.
options.textCn: 您说得对。我马上在系统里查订单详情。

options.text: Our partnership is irrelevant here. You should send everything by email instead.
options.textCn: 合作关系与这无关。您应该把一切发邮件给我。

options.text: I am too busy for this. Please deal with my colleague instead.
options.textCn: 我太忙了。请找我同事处理吧。

n4.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n4.line: Good. As for the price, our board proposes a five percent discount in exchange for a larger order.
n4.lineCn: 好。至于价格,我方董事会提议:若订单增大,则提供百分之五的折扣作为交换。

grammar.name: 介词短语 as for / in exchange for
grammar.note: as for 至于、关于;in exchange for 以……作为交换,是讨价还价的常用结构。

options.text: A five percent discount is acceptable in principle, but let me confirm the exact quantity.
options.textCn: 原则上可以接受百分之五的折扣,但请让我确认具体数量。
options.feedback: 原则接受,继续磋商细节。

options.text: In exchange for a larger order, we would need at least ten percent off.
options.textCn: 作为加量的交换,我们至少需要打九折。

options.text: The price is not my department. Please talk to our sales director in charge of pricing.
options.textCn: 价格不是我负责的。请找负责定价的销售总监谈。

n5.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n5.line: I am disappointed, to be honest. In spite of my efforts, we seem to be going around in circles.
n5.lineCn: 说实话,我很失望。尽管我多方努力,我们似乎一直在原地打转。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in spite of
grammar.note: in spite of 尽管,后接名词短语,引导让步,语气比 although 更正式。

options.text: I apologise for the confusion. From now on, I will personally take charge of this matter.
options.textCn: 我为混乱道歉。从现在起,我会亲自负责此事。

options.text: In spite of your disappointment, I cannot magically solve everything in one call.
options.textCn: 尽管您失望,我也无法一通电话变出一切。
options.feedback: 态度消极,对方进一步施压。

options.text: You are right to be frustrated. Due to my neglect, this call should have happened earlier.
options.textCn: 您有理由沮丧。由于我的疏忽,这通电话本该更早打。

n6.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n6.line: Thank you for your cooperation. In addition to the discount, we also ask for priority shipping.
n6.lineCn: 感谢您的配合。除了折扣之外,我们还要求优先发货。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in addition to
grammar.note: in addition to 除……之外(还),后接名词,用于逐条罗列要求。

options.text: Priority shipping is possible, provided that you cover the extra cost.
options.textCn: 优先发货可行,前提是贵方承担额外费用。

options.text: In addition to priority shipping, do you have any other requirements?
options.textCn: 除了优先发货,贵方还有其他要求吗?

options.text: Priority shipping is out of the question, regardless of what you offer.
options.textCn: 优先发货免谈,不管贵方提出什么条件。

n6b.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n6b.line: Very well. Let us also discuss the packaging specifications, especially in terms of moisture protection.
n6b.lineCn: 很好。我们再谈谈包装规格,尤其是在防潮方面。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in terms of(方面)
grammar.note: in terms of 在此限定讨论维度(防潮),与 especially 连用突出重点。

options.text: We will use waterproof materials in accordance with your previous requirements.
options.textCn: 我们会依照贵方以往的要求使用防水材料。

options.text: In terms of moisture, our standard packaging should suffice.
options.textCn: 就防潮而言,我们的标准包装应该足够。

options.text: Packaging is trivial. Let us focus on the money instead.
options.textCn: 包装是小事,我们还是谈钱吧。
options.feedback: 轻视细节,对方不以为然。

n7.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n7.line: In regard to the tone of this call, I must say your attitude is making negotiation difficult.
n7.lineCn: 就这通电话的氛围而言,我必须说您的态度让谈判变得困难。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in regard to
grammar.note: in regard to 关于、就……而言,正式用语,常见于书面沟通与正式场合。

options.text: I apologise. With respect to the earlier remarks, I spoke out of frustration, not intention.
options.textCn: 我道歉。关于之前的言论,那是出于沮丧,并非有意。

options.text: Regardless of your feelings, business is business. My terms stand.
options.textCn: 不管您感受如何,生意就是生意。我的条件不变。

options.text: I had no intention of sounding harsh. In comparison with our usual partners, we are quite flexible.
options.textCn: 我无意语气生硬。与我们通常的伙伴相比,我们相当灵活。

n8.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n8.line: Let us move forward, then. In accordance with the usual practice, we will pay a thirty percent deposit upon signing.
n8.lineCn: 那我们向前推进。按照惯例,签约时我们将支付三成定金。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in accordance with
grammar.note: in accordance with 依照、按照,是合同与正式文书的标准用语。

options.text: In accordance with our policy, we require the deposit before production starts.
options.textCn: 按照我方政策,生产开始前须收到定金。

options.text: A thirty percent deposit sounds reasonable. In return, we will send you the contract by tonight.
options.textCn: 三成定金合理。作为回报,我们今晚就把合同发给您。

options.text: Forget the deposit. In the event of default, we can sue each other.
options.textCn: 别谈定金了。一旦违约,我们互相起诉就行。

n8b.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n8b.line: Understood. Regarding insurance, we will arrange full coverage at our own expense.
n8b.lineCn: 明白。关于保险,我们将自费安排全额投保。

grammar.name: 介词 regarding
grammar.note: regarding 关于,与 with regard to 同义,口语与书面通用,商务电话自然衔接。

options.text: That is generous. In return, we will guarantee the quality of every batch.
options.textCn: 贵方很大方。作为回报,我方将保证每批货的质量。

options.text: Due to the high value of the goods, please ensure the insurance covers sea transport.
options.textCn: 鉴于货物价值高,请确保保险涵盖海运。

options.text: Insurance is unnecessary, in my view, due to the short shipping distance.
options.textCn: 依我看,运输距离短,保险没有必要。

n9.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n9.line: Excellent. In conclusion, we have agreed on price, delivery, and shipping. Anything else to add?
n9.lineCn: 很好。总而言之,我们已就价格、交货和运输达成一致。还有要补充的吗?

grammar.name: 介词短语 in conclusion
grammar.note: in conclusion 总之、最后,用于总结陈词,是正式交流的收尾用语。

options.text: One thing, in addition to what we have agreed: please mark every package in accordance with our labelling standards.
options.textCn: 除已商定内容外还有一点:请按我方标签标准标记每个包裹。

options.text: Nothing else. In the meantime, I will prepare the formal agreement.
options.textCn: 没有其他了。同时,我会准备正式协议。

options.text: I need to think it over. In case of further questions, I will email you tomorrow.
options.textCn: 我需要再想想。如有疑问,我明天发邮件。

n10.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
n10.line: Noted. In the event of any discrepancies, we will contact you within 48 hours.
n10.lineCn: 记下了。一旦出现任何不符,我们将在四十八小时内联系贵方。

grammar.name: 介词短语 in the event of
grammar.note: in the event of 如果发生……,引导可能出现的状况,是合同语言的常见表达。

options.text: Perfect. In comparison with previous orders, this process has been remarkably smooth.
options.textCn: 很好。与以往订单相比,这次流程异常顺畅。

options.text: I hope there will be no discrepancies. In any case, I trust your team.
options.textCn: 希望不会有差错。无论如何,我信任贵方团队。

options.text: On the whole, I am satisfied. I look forward to our future cooperation.
options.textCn: 总体而言,我很满意。期待我们未来的合作。

success.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
success.line: Then we are all set. With regard to the contract, you will receive it by email within the hour. Thank you for your time.
success.lineCn: 那我们一切就绪。关于合同,一小时内您将收到邮件。感谢您的时间。

fail1.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
fail1.line: I am sorry the negotiation could not continue. In hindsight, a little flexibility would have served both sides.
fail1.lineCn: 很遗憾谈判无法继续。事后看来,多一点灵活对双方都有利。

fail2.speaker: 客户经理 Mr. Davis
fail2.line: This conversation is over. Without trust, no contract is worth the paper it is printed on.
fail2.lineCn: 谈话到此为止。没有信任,任何合同都不值得它所用的那张纸。
